depiction.primary_object: diagonal pencil with rounded eraser top and pointed tip
modifiers: diagonal strike-through slash from top-left to bottom-right
depiction.composition: single tilted object crossed by a diagonal slash

readings.meaning: editing disabled, read-only mode, or cannot edit
stop writing, cancel draft, or lock document

ambiguity: Because the slash cuts right through the middle of the barrel where the collar sits, the shape closely resembles a crossed-out eyedropper/pipette or a broken sword at small sizes.
task_intents: revoke edit permissions for external users
protect master template from accidental changes
turn off guest commenting and editing
finalize contract text against further edits

reasoning: The icon depicts a pencil crossed out by a diagonal slash, representing 'edit off', 'read-only', or disabled editing. It fits tasks centered on locking documents, revoking write permissions, or freezing forms against changes, though at small sizes the bisected pencil can easily be mistaken for a crossed-out eyedropper or pipette.
